Use case: stylized-concept
Primary request: an original food-topic illustration of Zhoucun shaobing from Zibo: VERY THIN, round, crisp sesame crackers, not thick bread or filled meat pies. No filling, meat, puff pastry layers, bread roll or thick bun.

Controlled soft light and airy composition, not an advertising food photo or a claimed authentic merchant's serving.
Authenticity: the drawing is an invented representation of the thin sesame-cracker theme, not a standard recipe, quality guarantee, brand endorsement, royal-tribute story or documentation of the making technique. Do not add heritage emblems, certificates, seals or health claims.
One standalone horizontal 3:2 native artwork, ideally 1536x1024, not a UI, poster, map or contact sheet. Main object(s) fully visible with ample margins; not cropped at canvas edges. No real people, portraits, hands, readable text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, inscriptions, seals, signature, brand, logo or watermark. No existing artist's work, museum object, verified craft process or named product is copied.
